Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report onboarding — kickoff & templates

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, Acme will need our latest SOC 2 Type II report and a short bridge letter that clarifies the audit period and any in-flight control changes since the report's end date. To keep your procurement/compliance team moving, can you confirm the following and we'll assemble the package: 

- Desired audit period coverage (e.g., 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31)
- Formal contact for secure transfer (SFTP/Drive email)
- Any minimum documentation beyond the report (e.g., control narratives, configuration snapshots, evidence samples)

I'll loop in our compliance team to provide the package and a short reply template you can copy into procurement. Expect a follow-up from Kimberly with the bridge-letter draft and a one-line reply set.

Attachments: none on this message.

Thanks,

Hey Sean,

Thanks — quick answers below: 

- Audit period: we prefer the most recent 12-month Type II window; if your report covers 2024-04-01 to 2025-03-31 that works fine.
- Transfer: Secure Drive link to security@acmeanalytics.com works. If you prefer SFTP, we can share creds in a separate ticket.
- Documentation: our reviewers will want the report PDF, a one-page bridge letter if the report doesn't include the absolute latest controls, and examples of evidence for user access reviews + incident response.

Would you be able to provide a short one-line reply that our procurement lead can paste into an RFP response? Appreciate it.

Best,
Rachel Lee
Security Operations Lead, Acme Analytics
rlee@acmeanalytics.com
